Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Boarding School Hunting Ground
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Unique location. Hunting ground. Requires a ready vampire.
This card comes in play with 2 blood. During your untap phase, you can move 1 blood from this card to a ready vampire you control or add 1 blood to this card. This card can't have more than 2 blood. Burn this card when it has no blood. A vampire can gain blood from only one hunting ground each turn.

A generic hunting ground for the clans that don't have access to any (Bloodlines). Basically, you can use it two turns in a row and burn it, or use it only one turn out of two. Therefore the cost has been halved compared to a classical HG.

Thoughts?

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Santaleous is helped two time by this card, one time by the +1 bleed (additional hunting ground), and another time because with more blood filling he can cancel more master. Don't seem a problem, but may need caution.

Other than that, it's a niche card, since hunting ground aren't the most valuable asset already. That being said, this one may be better than a regular hunting ground, since it is playable without influenced vampire and is cheaper, requiring less time to pay itself.

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body: About the santaleous part, what you say is allready the case with other HG and since blood gain doesn't stack, I don't see any problem.
